stage_name: D3.5-A6 Phase 0 — Bounded Rerank-Admission Design & Preregistration Freeze
stage_type: design/preregistration-only stage; no runner implementation, no treatment pool construction, no reranker/analyzer/embedding/QA/verifier/judge calls, no runtime/D1/database changes

inherited_frozen_parameters.admission_policy_family: A — fixed small absolute rerank-pool admission reservation

frozen_v2_selectivity_surface.selected_ordering_field_in_result_artifa: six_case_records[case_id].selected_object_ids (verified equal to selected_rank_keys candidate order in all six cases)

scientific_question: Can a very small reserved rerank-admission budget allow already-selected, governed bridge evidence to compete in the existing reranker and achieve stable downstream evidence retention, while preserving ordinary-candidate competition and avoiding material control regressions?

staged_identifiability.selectivity_stage_status: D3.5-A5-R2 = COMPLETE / PASS (repaired v2 selectivity validated for development)

frozen_cases.source: the frozen A2 six-case development set
frozen_cases.role: POST_OUTCOME_MECHANISTIC_DEVELOPMENT — outcomes already exposed in A2/A5/R2; never represented as a fresh holdout

construction_chain: persisted A5-R2 final v2-conditioned graph channel (six_case_records[case_id].selectivity_only_graph_ordering, consumed as-is)

frozen fusion with unchanged non-graph channels (weights exact 2.0 / dense 1.0 / sparse 1.0 / paper 1.15 / workflow 1.2 / graph 0.8, score = weight / (60 + rank + 1), non-graph channels taken unchanged from the frozen STRUCTURED_BRIDGED cell trace)

full fused ordering (deterministic recomputation; tie-breaking per the existing frozen fusion implementation — stable descending sort over the fused score map with the frozen channel-traversal order, verified 6/6 by the Phase-0 probe)
top-30 BASELINE rerank pool (first 30 members of the full fused ordering)
baseline_definition.graph_authority_note: the persisted selectivity_only_graph_ordering is already the final v2-conditioned graph-channel ordering produced by the frozen v2 implementation (selected bridge prefix + ordinary unbridged graph under GRAPH_CHANNEL_LIMIT = 20); it is the runtime replay input as persisted
baseline_definition.phase1_double_graph_merge_prohibited: selectivity_only_graph_ordering must never be merged with the selected bridge prefix again; the authoritative field is already the merged final graph-channel ordering
baseline_definition.phase1_graph_parity_check: Phase 1 may verify persisted selectivity_only_graph_ordering == merge_ids(selected_object_ids, unbridged_graph_ordering, GRAPH_CHANNEL_LIMIT) for all six cases as an equivalence check only; the persisted ordering remains the replay input; if parity fails: STOP BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION FREEZE (no opportunistic representation choice)
baseline_definition.full_fused_ordering_authority: Phase 1 deterministically recomputes the full v2-conditioned fused ordering from the persisted final graph channel + frozen non-graph channels + frozen RRF weights; this is deterministic replay, not new retrieval
baseline_definition.A6_scientific_contrast: admission on top of repaired v2 selectivity

reservable_bridge_definition.V2_SELECTED_BRIDGE: the exact v2-selected bridge candidate ordering frozen by A5-R2 (six_case_records[case_id].selected_object_ids)
reservable_bridge_definition.BASELINE_TOP30: the ordinary frozen v2-conditioned fused rerank pool (top-30)
reservable_bridge_definition.RESERVABLE_BRIDGE: V2_SELECTED_BRIDGE minus candidates already present in BASELINE_TOP30
reservable_bridge_definition.admission_order: frozen v2 selectivity order (the V2_SELECTED_BRIDGE ordering); no new admission relevance score; bridge candidates are never reranked a second time before admission

pool_size_rule: every BASELINE/ADMISSION_K2/ADMISSION_K3 reranker input pool contains exactly 30 candidates unless fewer than 30 unique candidates exist in the frozen candidate universe for that case; the pool is never globally expanded

K2_semantics.reserved_set: the first min(2, len(RESERVABLE_BRIDGE)) candidates of RESERVABLE_BRIDGE in frozen v2 order

K3_semantics.reserved_set: the first min(3, len(RESERVABLE_BRIDGE)) candidates of RESERVABLE_BRIDGE in frozen v2 order

ceiling_not_quota.semantics: up to K candidates, never always K
ceiling_not_quota.empty_reservable_case: if len(RESERVABLE_BRIDGE) = 0, the K2 treatment pool equals the BASELINE pool and the K3 treatment pool equals the BASELINE pool
ceiling_not_quota.single_reservable_case: if exactly one reservable candidate exists, both arms reserve exactly one
ceiling_not_quota.unused_capacity: never filled with unrelated candidates (fail closed)

duplicate_admission_semantics.already_present_rule: a v2-selected bridge candidate already present in BASELINE_TOP30 stays in its ordinary baseline position and consumes 0 reserved slots
duplicate_admission_semantics.overlap_recording: baseline_overlap_bridge_ids recorded explicitly per treatment pool
duplicate_admission_semantics.no_duplicate_entries: no candidate is ever inserted twice into a pool

steps: take the first min(K, len(RESERVABLE_BRIDGE)) candidates of RESERVABLE_BRIDGE in frozen v2 order (the reserved set)
retain all BASELINE_TOP30 candidates except those mechanically displaced
keep the pool size fixed at 30

displacement_semantics.A4_rule: retain the baseline fused ordering and replace the lowest-ranked eligible baseline entries with reserved bridge candidates
displacement_semantics.displacement_start: from the bottom of BASELINE_TOP30 (positional, bottom-first)
displacement_semantics.bridge_derived_status_neutral: a candidate already present in the baseline pool is never displaced merely because it is bridge-derived; bridge-derived status neither protects nor targets any candidate

protected_baseline_entries.gold_based_protection: PROHIBITED (evaluator information never enters pool construction)
protected_baseline_entries.duplicate_exception: a v2-selected bridge candidate already present in the baseline pool occupies its own baseline slot and never receives a duplicate reservation entry

treatment_pool_order.frozen_ordering: surviving baseline candidates retain their original v2-conditioned fused order; reserved bridge candidates are appended after them in frozen v2 order
treatment_pool_order.rationale: preserves baseline ordering semantics and matches the production rerank-payload construction (payload list built in pool order); deterministic and implementation-unambiguous

candidate_authority.reservation_grants: permission to enter the ordinary reranker competition only

reranker_interface_freeze.contract: A6 reuses the existing production/evaluation reranker interface unchanged

observed_frozen_interface.call_site: src/panda_agent/retrieval.py (rerank pool construction and generate_json rerank call)
observed_frozen_interface.payload_shape: [{object_id, title, source_id, text[:2000]}] in pool order
observed_frozen_interface.response_schema: ranked_object_ids enum-restricted to the pool member list
observed_frozen_interface.decoding: vertex generate_json, temperature 0.0 (existing default), response_mime_type application/json
observed_frozen_interface.model: the environment-resolved generation model (VertexSettings.generation_model, default gemini-3.7-flash via QA_GENERATION_MODEL_ID)
observed_frozen_interface.provider_retry_policy: the existing 3-attempt transient-retry loop inside vertex generate_json, unchanged

phase0_and_phase1_prohibitions: modify the reranker candidate payload shape
reranker_interface_freeze.ambiguity_rule: if the exact currently used model/config cannot be recovered unambiguously: STOP BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION
reranker_interface_freeze.phase1_recording_requirement: the Phase-1 runner manifest must record the resolved model id and configuration actually used

repetition_rationale.3_repetitions: minimal odd-number repeated design supporting majority/median semantics
repetition_rationale.larger_counts: unnecessary Monte-Carlo-style expansion for this mechanistic stage
repetition_rationale.outcome_independence: the count is NOT chosen from A2/A5/R2 case outcomes

formal_call_accounting.provider_retries: internal provider retries, if any, are accounted separately from formal repetitions and never counted as repetitions

execution_schedule.rule: for each case in frozen case order, complete all 3 repetitions per the cyclic schedule before advancing to the next case

pairing_semantics.prohibited_claim: that BASELINE repetition r and treatment repetition r share random seeds or deterministic stochastic state unless the existing model interface actually supports that

QA_disabled.outcome_boundary: A6 outcome ends at reranked evidence; no answer generation is added

evaluator_contract.evaluator: the existing deterministic evidence evaluator (frozen GoldEvidenceSelector.matches semantics; expected evidence is evaluator-only)
evaluator_contract.post_rerank_deterministic_surface: each arm/repetition reranker output is deterministically post-processed with production-identical unchanged semantics over the POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_REPLAY_SURFACE (see the dedicated replay-surface contracts below): fallback merge ordered = dedupe([*reranker_output, *baseline_full_fused_order]) (the admission changes only the rerank pool; fusion state, scores, channels, and the fused fallback are identical across arms and admission grants no extra RRF vote), then the unchanged plan-driven deterministic reordering and unchanged select_final_evidence with the frozen final_evidence_limit (12, configs/retrieval_policies.yaml); the resulting final evidence is the arm/repetition evidence surface
evaluator_contract.retained_per_repetition: a required evidence group is retained in an arm/repetition iff the existing deterministic evaluator's group matching is satisfied by that arm/repetition evidence surface

RERANKER_PAYLOAD_SURFACE.definition: the exact payload submitted to the existing reranker
RERANKER_PAYLOAD_SURFACE.purpose: exists only to call the unchanged reranker
RERANKER_PAYLOAD_SURFACE.prohibition: no selector-only metadata is added to the model prompt

POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_REPLAY_SURFACE.definition: a separate deterministic replay surface, independent of the reranker payload, sufficient to reproduce the existing production post-rerank logic exactly
required_per_object_fields: full locator (complete raw locator dict exactly as production payloads carry; the duplicate-locator identity is the canonical JSON dump of the entire locator, so no key may be dropped)
channel membership (reproducible from the frozen channel orderings)
fusion score (reproducible from the frozen fusion contract)
POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_REPLAY_SURFACE.implementation_defined_fields: PROHIBITED — every required field is frozen here; observed Phase-0 registry gaps (source_version_id, authority_level, full text, paper_page_hints plan field, exact-channel members outside the old registry union) are materialized generically in Phase 1

POST_RERANK_REPLAY_REQUIRED_OBJECT_UNIVE.definition: the union of: (1) every object in the full v2-conditioned fused ordering; (2) every object in the frozen exact channel needed for symbol_first; (3) every reserved bridge candidate; (4) every additional object referenced by deterministic final-selector logic before final_evidence_limit can be satisfied
POST_RERANK_REPLAY_REQUIRED_OBJECT_UNIVE.mechanically_computed_superset: under the frozen fusion construction every channel member (including exact-channel members and graph-channel bridge candidates) receives a fused score, and ordered = dedupe([*reranker_output, *full_fused_order]) only ever contains fused-ordering members (reranker outputs are pool members and every pool member is a fused-ordering member), so the complete required universe equals the member set of the full v2-conditioned fused ordering; Phase 1 computes it deterministically per case and materializes full replay fields for every member — a complete superset, never outcome-shaped incremental filling

selector_text_semantics.chosen_contract: OPTION A — persist the complete selector-visible frozen text needed by production logic
repository_evidence_full_text_is_consume: symbol_first checks plan symbols against the exact-channel item's full text (src/panda_agent/retrieval.py: literal in item['text'])
_evidence constructs Evidence.text from the full payload text (src/panda_agent/retrieval.py)
the frozen evaluator's title_contains check searches the evidence item's full text joined with title and section_path (src/panda_agent/evaluation.py GoldEvidenceSelector.matches)
selector_text_semantics.why_OPTION_B_rejected: text[:2000] == production selector text cannot be proven: whether a plan symbol or title_contains needle occurs beyond character 2000 is data-dependent, so no generic mechanical equivalence proof exists; assuming equality without proof is prohibited
selector_text_semantics.scope: the complete frozen normalized record text for every object in POST_RERANK_REPLAY_REQUIRED_OBJECT_UNIVERSE; the reranker model still receives text[:2000] only (RERANKER_PAYLOAD_SURFACE is unchanged)

replay_registry_separation.rule: model-visible reranker fields and selector-only replay fields must be explicitly separated (e.g., distinct reranker_payload_registry and selector_replay_registry, or equivalently namespaced fields)
replay_registry_separation.prohibition: silently overloading the existing payload registry such that model-visible fields and selector-only fields become indistinguishable
replay_registry_separation.schema_choice: the exact Phase-1 schema may be chosen in Phase 1; this semantic separation is frozen now

complete_replay_surface_gate.rule: before any Phase-2 reranker outcome, Phase 1 mechanically materializes the full required replay surface (100% of POST_RERANK_REPLAY_REQUIRED_OBJECT_UNIVERSE with all POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_REPLAY_SURFACE fields) from the frozen normalized corpus and frozen trace state; runtime KeyError-driven incremental repair (KeyError -> add one object -> rerun) is PROHIBITED
gate_conditions: post-rerank deterministic selector replay synthetic/parity tests pass

POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_PARITY_TARGET: production retrieval.py deterministic post-rerank behavior, including ordered fallback construction, preferred_sources, symbol_first, required_first, hinted_first, final ordered deduplication, select_final_evidence, and final_evidence_limit = 12; no simplified evaluation-only substitute unless proven semantically identical

retention_definitions.STABLE_RETAINED: required evidence group retained in at least 2 of 3 reranker repetitions (retention_count >= 2)
retention_definitions.STABLE_LOST: required evidence group retained in at most 1 of 3 repetitions

rank_diagnostics.per_repetition_record: reranked rank if retained; absent otherwise
rank_diagnostics.aggregation: median retained rank only, as a secondary diagnostic
rank_diagnostics.rank_limitation: rank improvement alone does NOT determine K selection

pool_fingerprint_definition.pool_fingerprint: deterministic hash over the ordered pool member object_id list exactly as submitted to the reranker (pool membership and ordering)
pool_fingerprint_definition.identical_pool_rule: arms whose pool fingerprints are identical submitted identical reranker inputs

baseline_variance_reference.RERANKER_VARIANCE_REFERENCE: when a treatment pool equals the BASELINE pool (identical fingerprint), any observed output difference between separate reranker calls is reranker variance reference, not admission effect

treatment_effect_interpretation.rule: admission effect may be interpreted only when the treatment rerank pool differs from the BASELINE rerank pool (different fingerprint)
treatment_effect_interpretation.identical_fingerprint_rule: if pool fingerprints are identical, output differences are never attributed to admission

material_control_regression_definition.BASELINE_STABLE: required/control evidence group retained in >= 2 of 3 BASELINE repetitions
material_control_regression_definition.MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION: BASELINE retention_count >= 2 AND treatment retention_count <= 1 for the same group (repetition-aware; filters single-run reranker variance)

non_material_fluctuations.exception: unless another frozen primary invariant is violated

DEFAULT_BUDGET_PREFERENCE: K2 (as the smaller displacement within the causal-safe hierarchy; the binding principle is the smallest sufficient causally witnessed safe budget)
smallest_sufficient_budget_rationale: superseded wording retained for provenance: K2 displaces fewer ordinary candidates; under D3.5-A6-PHASE0-R1-R1, K3 must demonstrate additional CAUSAL_DELTA_3 > CAUSAL_DELTA_2 (causally witnessed benefit), not merely larger DELTA_K, to override K2

admission_benefit_population.ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP: a required evidence group is an ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP iff the deterministic evaluator identifies at least one required candidate for that group AND at least one such required candidate belongs to RESERVABLE_BRIDGE for that case
admission_benefit_population.classification_timing: evaluator-only; occurs after pool construction and output freeze; must never affect runtime admission
admission_benefit_population.already_baseline_bridge_evidence: a required bridge candidate already present in BASELINE_TOP30 consumes zero reservation slots, so its group is useful for control/retention diagnostics but does not count as evidence that reserved admission created incremental reachability

admission_safety_population.safety_population: all evaluator-required/control groups that are BASELINE_STABLE (not only admission-target groups)

incremental_benefit_metrics.DELTA_K: number of ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUPs that are STABLE_RETAINED under treatment K AND NOT STABLE_RETAINED under BASELINE
incremental_benefit_metrics.DELTA_2: incremental admission benefit of K2 (primary benefit count)
incremental_benefit_metrics.DELTA_3: incremental admission benefit of K3 (primary benefit count)
incremental_benefit_metrics.primary_rule: budget selection is based on incremental admission benefit + safety; total stable retained groups are never the primary K benefit metric

safety_metrics.REGRESSION_K: number of MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION groups under budget K
safety_metrics.applies_to: the safety population (all BASELINE_STABLE evaluator-required/control groups)

causal_benefit_metrics.CAUSAL_DELTA_K: number of ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUPs that satisfy BOTH: (1) the group is STABLE_RETAINED under treatment K AND NOT STABLE_RETAINED under BASELINE; (2) the same group has STABLE_RESERVED_REQUIRED_WITNESS under treatment K
causal_benefit_metrics.equivalent_reading: stable incremental admission recovery with a stable actually-reserved required-candidate witness
causal_benefit_metrics.CAUSAL_DELTA_2: causal admission benefit of K2 (primary mechanistic benefit count)
causal_benefit_metrics.CAUSAL_DELTA_3: causal admission benefit of K3 (primary mechanistic benefit count)
causal_benefit_metrics.interpretation_boundary: DELTA_K = stable downstream recovery after admission-induced pool perturbation; CAUSAL_DELTA_K = stable downstream recovery directly witnessed by an actually reserved required bridge candidate; the two are never conflated
causal_benefit_metrics.NONCAUSAL_STABLE_DELTA_K: DELTA_K - CAUSAL_DELTA_K; diagnostic only — stable improvement correlated with the admission-modified pool but not mechanistically carried by an actually reserved required candidate; never used to claim direct bridge-admission recovery

SAFE_EFFECTIVE.superseded_for_pass_selection: superseded for PASS selection by D3.5-A6-PHASE0-R1-R1 — budget selection now uses MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE
SAFE_EFFECTIVE.retained_role: preserved as a broader pool-level diagnostic only
SAFE_EFFECTIVE.ordering: the safety filter occurs BEFORE smallest-budget preference

MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE.unsafe_budget_rule: if CAUSAL_DELTA_K > 0 but REGRESSION_K > 0 then MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE(K) = false; safety still precedes budget minimality

corrected_K2_K3_decision_rule.superseded_by: causal_safe_budget_decision_rule (D3.5-A6-PHASE0-R1-R1) — retained as historical provenance, not deleted
hierarchy: if K2 is SAFE_EFFECTIVE and K3 is SAFE_EFFECTIVE: SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 3 if DELTA_3 > DELTA_2 else 2
else: no budget is selected as PASS
corrected_K2_K3_decision_rule.meaning: implements smallest sufficient SAFE budget, not merely smallest budget
corrected_K2_K3_decision_rule.rank_only_improvement_rule: if DELTA_2 == DELTA_3 and both are safe-effective: choose K2, even if K3 improves median rank or MRR-like diagnostics; rank-only improvement cannot justify K3
corrected_K2_K3_decision_rule.unsafe_smaller_budget_rule: DELTA_2 == DELTA_3 -> choose K2 is PROHIBITED when REGRESSION_2 > 0 AND REGRESSION_3 == 0; safety is evaluated before budget minimality
corrected_K2_K3_decision_rule.budget_identity_prohibition: the budget is never chosen from positive-case identity

causal_safe_budget_decision_rule.DEFAULT_BUDGET_PRINCIPLE: smallest sufficient causally witnessed safe budget — not the smallest budget and not the largest DELTA_K budget
hierarchy: if K2 is MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE and K3 is MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE: SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 3 if CAUSAL_DELTA_3 > CAUSAL_DELTA_2 else 2
else: no budget is selected as PASS
causal_safe_budget_decision_rule.k3_beats_k2_only_on_causal_benefit: if both budgets are mechanistically safe, CAUSAL_DELTA_3 > CAUSAL_DELTA_2 selects K3, otherwise K2; a pure increase in DELTA_K, median rank, MRR-like diagnostics, or NONCAUSAL_STABLE_DELTA_K can never by itself justify K3

frozen_synthetic_edge_case.note: design-only synthetic example, not a real-case test
frozen_synthetic_edge_case.correct_decision: SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 2 — only K2 provides causally witnessed bridge-admission recovery; K3's larger noncausal DELTA_3 never wins

causal_safe_budget_decision_rule.budget_identity_prohibition: the budget is never chosen from positive-case identity

causal_witness_contract.RESERVED_REQUIRED_CANDIDATE_RETAINED: evaluator-only diagnostic: for each ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP/repetition, record whether the final evidence actually contains a required-evidence matching candidate that consumed a reserved slot in that treatment arm
causal_witness_contract.purpose: supports the mechanistic claim that reserved bridge admission itself recovered the required evidence
causal_witness_contract.PASS_requirement: PASS / BOUNDED_RERANK_ADMISSION_VALIDATED_FOR_DEVELOPMENT requires at least one MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE budget; the stable reserved-required-candidate witness is embedded in CAUSAL_DELTA_K itself and is not separately re-required after budget selection; without that witness, direct bridge-admission recovery is not claimed

POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY.definition: final evidence improves relative to baseline but the improvement is not carried by an actually reserved required candidate
POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY.classification: recorded as a diagnostic only; does NOT by itself satisfy the mechanistic PASS requirement
POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY.quantitative_relationship: if DELTA_K > CAUSAL_DELTA_K, the difference NONCAUSAL_STABLE_DELTA_K corresponds to stable pool-level recovery not backed by a stable reserved-required-candidate witness; no runtime effect

UNSTABLE_ADMISSION_RECOVERY.definition: an ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP is retained in at least one treatment repetition where the corresponding BASELINE repetition/stable baseline state does not establish stable retention, but the group does not satisfy DELTA_K stable recovery
UNSTABLE_ADMISSION_RECOVERY.isolation_rule: isolated reranker variance is never confused with stable treatment effect

K2_vs_K3_decision_rule.scope: across all evaluator-applicable required evidence groups
K2_vs_K3_decision_rule.S2: number of applicable evidence groups STABLE_RETAINED by K2
K2_vs_K3_decision_rule.S3: number of applicable evidence groups STABLE_RETAINED by K3
rules: if S3 > S2 AND K3 has no additional MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION relative to K2: prefer K3
if S3 > S2 BUT K3 introduces additional MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION: do not automatically prefer K3; verdict becomes PARTIAL / tradeoff
K2_vs_K3_decision_rule.rank_only_improvement_rule: if S2 == S3 and K3 only improves median rank or MRR-like rank diagnostics, SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 2 (rank quality alone never justifies the extra displaced slot)
K2_vs_K3_decision_rule.budget_identity_prohibition: the budget is never chosen from positive-case identity

origin_concentration_diagnostics.numeric_failure_threshold: NONE (never derived from g020 v2 origins_after = 2 or the 4+4 attribution)
origin_concentration_diagnostics.admission_diversity_enforcement: A6 does not modify admission to enforce diversity
origin_concentration_diagnostics.existing_v2_per_origin_cap: PER_ORIGIN_CAP = 4 remains the selectivity-stage guard and is unchanged; no new per-origin admission cap is added inside A6 (A6 tests its downstream consequence)

control_interpretation_boundary.post_output_reporting: evaluator/reporting may retain the existing frozen case-role metadata for scientific interpretation after outputs are produced

outcome_exposure_contract.exposure_starts_when: the first real-case reranker call starts (TREATMENT_EXECUTION_EXPOSURE)
exposure_does_not_start_when: a result is persisted (PERSISTED_RESULT_EXPOSURE is a later layer)
a human reads the result (HUMAN_RESULT_INSPECTION is a later layer)

phase0_prohibited_probes: constructing a real case treatment pool and running it 'just to verify'
running a real-case baseline smoke test
running one reranker call to estimate variance
anti_tuning_contract.outcome_independent_design: K, repetition count, material regression threshold, pool order, and budget decision semantics are never tuned from exposed A5/R2 result details

payload_availability_contingency.problem_class: a v2-conditioned pool/replay-surface member may be absent from the frozen fixture payload registry because the registry covers the union of the OLD-cap fused top-30 and all bridge candidates, while v2 conditioning re-admits previously displaced ordinary graph candidates and the selector replay surface needs more fields than the registry persists

phase0_feasibility_probe.method: read-only deterministic fusion recomputation over frozen artifacts (fixture channel rankings + persisted R2 selectivity_only_graph_ordering), no selectivity execution, no model calls; deterministic frozen-trace feasibility inspection, never reinterpreted as an experiment
phase0_feasibility_probe.old_fusion_reproduction_check: the same fusion code path reproduces the frozen baseline_fused_ordering_full top-30 exactly for all six cases (6/6)
phase0_feasibility_probe.observed_missing_candidate_example: concept.restgas_longitudinal_efficiency (g020, ordinary graph candidate re-admitted under v2 conditioning); recorded as a currently visible example only — no object or case is special-cased

payload_availability_contingency.generic_phase1_rule: mechanically materialize ALL missing required replay objects (the complete POST_RERANK_REPLAY_REQUIRED_OBJECT_UNIVERSE with all POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_REPLAY_SURFACE fields) from the frozen normalized corpus and frozen trace state before Phase-2 exposure; no case-specific branch, no KeyError-driven incremental repair

verdict_precedence.note: supersedes the Phase0-R1 6-level precedence; total and non-overlapping with no outcome-dependent label selection
total_deterministic_order_no_outcome_dep: 2. FAIL / BOUNDED_ADMISSION_CONSTRUCTION_OR_AUTHORITY_FAILED (structural construction / authority / implementation invariant failure only)
3. PASS / BOUNDED_RERANK_ADMISSION_VALIDATED_FOR_DEVELOPMENT if at least one MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE budget exists
4. PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_WITH_CONTROL_REGRESSION if stable DELTA_K > 0 exists but every stable-recovery budget is unsafe
5. PARTIAL / POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY_WITHOUT_RESERVED_WITNESS if at least one safe budget has DELTA_K > 0 but no safe budget has CAUSAL_DELTA_K > 0
6. PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_NOT_STABLE_ACROSS_RERANKER_REPETITIONS if DELTA_2 = DELTA_3 = 0 but UNSTABLE_ADMISSION_RECOVERY exists
verdict_precedence.safe_budget_meaning_in_precedence: a budget is safe in precedence levels 4-5 when REGRESSION_K == 0 (MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION is a scientific budget-safety outcome, not a structural FAIL)

requires_all: at least one MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE budget exists
SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET chosen by the frozen causal-safe hierarchy (causal_safe_budget_decision_rule)
PASS.no_separate_witness_after_selection: the stable reserved-required-candidate witness is already embedded in CAUSAL_DELTA_K; it is not re-required after budget selection

scientific_verdict_rules.K2_PASS_selection: governed by causal_safe_budget_decision_rule: if both budgets are MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE, K2 is selected unless CAUSAL_DELTA_3 > CAUSAL_DELTA_2
scientific_verdict_rules.K3_PASS_selection: governed by causal_safe_budget_decision_rule: K3 is selected only when it is MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE and CAUSAL_DELTA_3 > CAUSAL_DELTA_2 (or K2 is not MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE)

PARTIAL_ADMISSION_RECOVERY_WITH_CONTROL_.scope: exists K with DELTA_K > 0 AND for every budget with DELTA_K > 0: REGRESSION_K > 0 (stable recovery exists but no stable-recovery budget is safe); may include causal or noncausal recovery; no PASS budget exists

PARTIAL_POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_REC.use_when: there exists at least one budget K with DELTA_K > 0 AND REGRESSION_K == 0, BUT for every safe budget: CAUSAL_DELTA_K == 0
PARTIAL_POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_REC.interpretation: admission-modified rerank pools produced stable downstream recovery, but the experiment did not validate that an actually reserved required bridge candidate carried that recovery; scientifically stronger than no downstream recovery but weaker than mechanistic PASS
PARTIAL_POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_REC.NONCAUSAL_STABLE_DELTA_K_role: the per-budget diagnostic quantity behind this class (DELTA_K - CAUSAL_DELTA_K); never used to claim direct bridge-admission recovery

PARTIAL_ADMISSION_DID_NOT_VALIDATE_DOWNS.scope: only when DELTA_2 = 0, DELTA_3 = 0, and no UNSTABLE_ADMISSION_RECOVERY (the true residual no-recovery class)
